what_happened: Up-first accounting closes on paper before any prototype: raise by d = budget copies of the pigeonhole block [u,u+l), run the landed overshoot loop ABOVE the run from w0 = u+(b+1)*l with target R = m*q (deletes t*l, R <= t < R+b), then delete the exact remainder r = R+b-t in [1,b] inside the run as the single block [u, u+r*l) (type-respecting by copy-boundary types). Slack needed on the original is exactly m*(P+1) (raise adds b*l of slack, loop needs R*l+b*l, outputs r*l); room needs only u+l <= z+b (hul from the within-pigeonhole) and b*(b+1) <= Tc; the gap needs only n <= c. No budget-squared term anywhere.

First prototype (iterSpliceIdx with 7 characterization lemmas, hasForwardSlack_raise, the re-derived iterated duplication exposing objAt and tpOf at EVERY position through the index map, and its register-held wrapper) elaborated fully PROVED on the first lake env lean run: exit 0, zero errors, one unused-binder warning (hzu, dropped). Saved as prototype/upfirst-helpers-compiled.lean.

Four lake env lean rounds total; every failure was an omega cast-form mismatch (push_cast splitting the budget product; a hand-written bound elaborating with the coercion at the leaves) or a dropped binder (l <= budget feeds budget >= 1 in the loop's base case). Final run: exit 0, zero errors, zero warnings.
